evidence: Diagnostics no longer assert an environmental cause the predicate has not established. New `_signal_origin_advice()` splits three classes: reaper-shaped (SIGTERM/SIGKILL/SIGINT/SIGHUP) keeps the external-kill + VM-load advice; crash-class (SIGSEGV/SIGABRT/SIGBUS/SIGILL/SIGFPE) points at the PAYLOAD/runtime; an unknown 128+N is explicitly unclassified with no cause asserted. Default wording is origin-neutral ("a signal termination" / "terminated by signal"). Retry policy unchanged (one retry for every class — transient vs reproducible discrimination). Pinned by 2 new discriminating tests (crash-class + unclassified) verified to FAIL against round-1 wording via a git-show scratch demo, plus positive reaper-advice asserts added to the existing SIGTERM double-kill test.
